experiment: Experiment 6B - Global information-matched topology-free neural baseline
architecture_status: identical to successful Elite Phase 2A run
claim_boundary: heterogeneous pooled-cohort consistency; NOT unseen-competition or external transfer
primary_scientific_question: Does adjacency-aware graph learning outperform an information-matched topology-free neural representation in the Global pooled cohort?
fusion: exact existing learned sigmoid scalar late fusion
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the three new Experiment 6B McNemar tests

interpretation_rules.graph_supported: Graph-specific advantage is supported only if the paired confidence interval for the adjacency-aware model advantage excludes zero.
interpretation_rules.graph_inconclusive: If the graph model has a positive point estimate but the CI crosses zero, report the advantage as suggestive but not established.
interpretation_rules.no_graph_requirement: If topology-free and graph models perform similarly, conclude that graph learning is not shown to be necessary.
interpretation_rules.topology_free_better: If topology-free model performs better, report the result without redesigning or retuning the baseline.
